# databasus_health_check_config (Resource)

A resource to manage health-check settings for a configured database

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "databasus_workspace" "example" {
  name = "my-workspace-local-storage"
}

resource "databasus_database_postgresql" "example" {
  name            = "my-postgres-db"
  database        = "my-test-db"
  host            = "my-db-host.local"
  port            = 5432
  ssl_mode        = "require"
  username        = "test-user"
  password        = "test-pwd"
  include_schemas = ["public"]
  workspace_id    = resource.databasus_workspace.example.id
}

resource "databasus_health_check_config" "example" {
  database_id                        = resource.databasus_database_postgresql.example.id
  health_check_enabled               = true
  sent_notification_when_unavailable = true
  attempts_before_considered_down    = 1
  store_attempts_days                = 1
  interval_minutes                   = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) The Id of the database config this health-check configuration applies for
- `health_check_enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable health-check monitoring for the referenced database

### Optional

- `attempts_before_considered_down` (Number) Number of failed health-check attempts before marking database as down. Defaults to 3
- `interval_minutes` (Number) How often to check database health (in minutes). Defaults to 1
- `sent_notification_when_unavailable` (Boolean) Send notifications when database becomes unavailable. Defaults to false.

Note: please make sure you have a notifier configured as well for the database if you set this to true.
- `store_attempts_days` (Number) How many days to store health check attempt history. Defaults to 7
